Let Rδ be their centered unit-height remainders, patched by zero, and let Uδ, Fδ be their open union and closed complement in B0. Fix real tests f1, . . . , fℓ ∈ C∞ c (B0), u1, . . . , uℓ ∈ R, and d0 > 0. Put Aδ,d0 = ( dist [ i supp fi, Fδ ! ≥ d0 ) . Then E " 1Aδ,d0 E " exp i X i uiRδ(fi) ! Eδ # − exp  − 1 2a2 X i,j uiujGUδ (fi, fj)   # −→ 0. (6.17) Here GUδ is the continuum Dirichlet kernel of the resolved open chamber union, with zero covariance between its components. 61 Multiplying the displayed difference by any uniformly bounded Eδ-measurable variable preserves the same estimate with its clearance indicator. To state the limiting consequence, let E be a Polish space and let eδ be an Eδ-measurable E-valued variable. Suppose, for one fixed s < −1, that along a subsequence (eδ, Fδ, Rδ) =⇒ (e, F, R) in E × K(B0) × Hs loc(B0), where K(B0) is the space of nonempty compact sets with the Hausdorff metric. The limit F is almost surely connected and contains ∂B0. Put U = B0 \ F and AF = ( dist [ i supp fi, F ! > 0 ) . Then, almost surely, 1AF E " exp i X i uiR(fi) ! σ(e, F) # = 1AF exp  − 1 2a2 X i,j uiujGU (fi, fj)   . (6.18) Thus, conditional on σ(e, F), the restrictions of R to the component interiors of U are independent zero-boundary GFFs divided by a, including components born from a pinched single precursor. This is first tested on deterministic compact buffers with positive limiting clearance and then extended by a countable exhaustion. The retained variable eδ may encode any exact-cut coordinates and flat constants for which this joint convergence holds; the constants are added after the centered assertion. Its Eδ-measurability excludes data from any later revelation.
